pokedexEntries.sw: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

pokedexEntries.sh: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

pokedexEntries.sc: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

pokedexEntries.vi: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.
